defects.defect: Missed existing Lead.POS_System__c (picklist 'POS System Used': Square, Toast, Clover, Revel, Lightspeed, Other). The spec creates Storefront__c.POS_Provider__c with no mention of the Lead field, its value set, or whether it should be mapped at lead conversion; the grounding says only that no POS field exists on the four menu objects.
defects.skill_gap: SKILL.md missed-components guidance searches readers/writers of the target objects but has no instruction to search other objects for fields representing the same concept (e.g. by name/label keyword) before creating a new field.

defects.defect: Grounding bullet on permission sets, labelled 'verified by org query', enumerates Delete grants on Menu_Item__c/Storefront__c as Agentforce_Reference_App only; the org also shows sfdc_accelerate_dms with Delete on both objects.
defects.skill_gap: None exists; no instruction that an enumerated list presented as verified must be complete or marked partial.

defects.defect: ExternalCredential existence was recorded as unverifiable because the standard-API query failed, but the Tooling API query on ExternalCredential works with the allowed commands (it returns Pronto_Orders_API_Key and Pronto_Pass_Factory_Key; no Toast credential). The Create of Toast_External_Credential was therefore left unverified when it could have been checked.
defects.skill_gap: org-verification.md has no ExternalCredential query (the run flagged this in skill_friction); adding the Tooling query would prevent it.

defects.defect: Mixed credential model: Square uses per-storefront Named Credentials via POS_Credential_Name__c, while Toast uses a single shared Toast_API; POS_Credential_Name__c is also required non-blank for Toast storefronts in the batch start query, even though the Toast path ignores it.
